description: This file defines an immutable class 'ImmutableJsonDouble' representing a JSON number that fits into a Java double, with utility methods for type checking, conversion, equality, and serialization.

classes.name: ImmutableJsonDouble
classes.description: An immutable class representing a JSON double value, extending AbstractJsonNumber<Double> with methods for type checking, conversion, equality, hash code, and serialization.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create a new ImmutableJsonDouble instance with the given double value.

methods.name: isDouble
methods.description: Returns true indicating this object represents a double.

methods.name: isInt
methods.description: Checks if the double value is also an integer.

methods.name: isLong
methods.description: Checks if the double value is also a long.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides Object's equals method to compare based on value and type.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code based on the value's type.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Serializes the double value using the provided SerializationContext, optimizing to save space if possible.

methods.name: getUpperBoundForStringSize
methods.description: Provides an upper bound on string length for serialization purposes.
